# situation: the job deploy has an if of two ${{ }} joined by && outside
#   them, meant to run the job only for a push to main.
# reason: GitHub reads the if as the string "true && false" or "false &&
#   false", which is not empty and so true: the job runs for every push and
#   every pull request of every branch.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }} && ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh
